seoTitle: Angle Converter: Degrees, Radians, Gradians, Turns
metaDescription: Convert degrees, radians, gradians, turns, arcminutes and mils, with radians as a multiple of pi. Free.
intro: Converts angles between degrees, radians, gradians, turns, arcminutes, arcseconds and NATO mils, and shows degrees-minutes-seconds and the multiple of pi.
why:
Code, maps and CAD tools each use another angle unit. Radians are the default in most maths libraries, degrees in everyday life.

The tool shows the result as a multiple of pi when it is a simple fraction, and as degrees, minutes and seconds.
howTo: Read the other units, the pi form and DMS.

faq.q: How many degrees is pi radians?

faq.a: A unit where a right angle is 100 gradians, so a full turn is 400.
Only simple fractions with a denominator up to 360 are shown.
